text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 4: XGBoost models given CAMS, or CAMS + ERA5 + UKV + ICON-D2 + ICON-EU + ICON global, track measured solar output'
text.tspan: Figure 4: XGBoost models given CAMS, or CAMS + ERA5 + UKV + ICON-D2 +
ICON-EU + ICON global, track measured solar output

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Hourly output as a percentage of capacity, measured and as predicted out of fold by each XGBoost model, averaged over its three fitting seeds. One row per generator; gaps are hours not covered by every product. Weeks chosen by rule from the weeks in which every generator has at least 4 scored hours on each of the seven days: the highest mean output, the largest day-to-day spread in daily mean output, and the lowest mean output. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.'
text.tspan: Hourly output as a percentage of capacity, measured and as predicted out of fold by each XGBoost model, averaged
over its three fitting seeds. One row per generator; gaps are hours not covered by every product.
Weeks chosen by rule from the weeks in which every generator has at least 4 scored hours on each of the seven days:
the highest mean output, the largest day-to-day spread in daily mean output, and the lowest mean output.
Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September
